title: Design brief - city road off Jhang Road, Faisalabad
summary: Rehabilitation and widening of about 2 km of city road: 7.3 m dual carriageway with a central median, shoulders, footpaths, piped storm drain with box culverts, LED street lighting and shifting of water and gas lines.

format.energy: LED street lighting with photocell control

programme.label: Right of way, about 2 km at 30 m

topics.site_analysis: Built-up frontage of shops on both sides; road stays open to traffic in one direction during the works.
topics.supply: FESCO supply for street lighting with photocell control; water and gas lines shifted by WASA and SNGPL.
topics.building_structure: Flexible pavement: granular sub-base, aggregate base course, asphalt base and wearing course; RCC box culverts.
topics.construction_method: Half-width construction in 500 m stretches with traffic diversion approved by the FDA traffic engineering wing.
topics.commissioning_sequence: Storm drain flushed and tested before the asphalt; street lights energised by FESCO before taking-over.

studies.title: Traffic count and axle load survey
studies.scope: Seven-day classified count and axle load survey at Jhang Road.
studies.author: Indus Highway Consultants
studies.result: About 18,000 vehicles a day with a high share of loaded trucks; design traffic 10 million standard axles.

studies.title: Subgrade investigation
studies.scope: CBR tests along the alignment every 250 m.
studies.author: Indus Highway Consultants
studies.result: Soaked CBR between 4 and 7 percent. Two stretches need improved subgrade.

issue_note: Design brief per the approved PC-I, issued for construction.
